note: The current input buffer is treated as a C-style string and scanned for a terminator.
Only the declared byte count is checked before the terminator scan, not the actual scanned string length.
The safety obligation is that the terminator search must not exceed the declared length; capping after the scan is too late.

code: if (!convert_string_talloc(ndr->current_mem_ctx, chset, CH_UNIX, ndr->data+ndr->offset, str_len*byte_mul, discard_const_p(void *, var), &converted_size))
note: The computed length is then used to read and convert from the buffer, so an overlong scan can trigger an out-of-bounds read.
